units.spine: The Elected Reeve is tolerated and not supported, and a hard decision here has to be paid for out of an empty purse.
The weekly market fills and the quarry sells, and the credit for both goes to the Elected Reeve.
The village expects the Elected Reeve to go on holding the seat at Hochhausen, and business here is done on that footing.
Nothing here governs cleanly, and the Elected Reeve decides at the pace of whichever power in the arrangement is least willing.

units.poolKey: governing body name: a SLOT, never a baked noun
units.spine: The office that governs here is the Elected Reeve, and the name is exact about the size of the place in a way outsiders regularly mistake.
Some here would take the seat if they could, and they cannot, and both sides understand the arrangement exactly.

units.poolKey: legitimacyHold: public opinion neither helps nor hurts
units.spine: Public opinion here neither helps the Elected Reeve nor hurts it, and the seat governs on its own strength.
